target_customer: Veterinary practices and veterinarians (and pet owners filling prescriptions)
problem: Veterinary prescriptions were handled by phone, fax and paper; vets lacked e-prescribing tied to pharmacies.

founders.name: Georgia Jeremiah
founders.background_notes: Described on YC page as a veterinarian.

exit.acquirer: MWI Animal Health (per CB Insights via search result; not independently confirmed)

technical_complexity.rationale: E-prescribing UI plus pharmacy integrations; moderate for a small team.

defensibility.rationale: Practice workflow integration could create stickiness, but no evidence either way.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Per a CB Insights snippet, MWI Animal Health acquired Furmacy in July 2025; unconfirmed by a press release.

market_need_then: Veterinary pharmacy distributors were building digital prescribing; a veterinarian co-founder indicates first-hand pain. No dated demand source found.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand sources found; name blends fur and pharmacy by appearance but no source states it.

outcome_analysis: Furmacy, a Winter 2021 YC veterinary e-prescribing company founded by a veterinarian and a co-founder, is listed as Acquired by YC and, per a CB Insights search result, was bought by MWI Animal Health in July 2025. Price, funding and reasons are not public in sources reached, so the outcome type is an acquisition of unknown size.
